info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to contract, to reduce, to constrict

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: nopaDaH . kftaparasavarRanirdeSaH . ' taYjU ' iti kzIrasvAmisammataH pAWaH . jakArAntamaDye pAWAt evameva nyAyyam iti tadASayaH .

examples: 'daDnA paya Atanakti.' payasi daDyAsicya tat saMhataM karotItyarTaH.
'indrasya tvA BAgaM somenAtanacmi' (vA0 saM0 1.4). somAsecanena sAndraM karomItyAha.
'tadezeva vratacaryA yatpUrvedyurdugDaM daDi havirAtaYcanaM tat kurvanti' (Sa0 brA0 11.1.4.1). havirAtaYcanaM havizaH sAndrIkaraRam.
'yo daDiDAnyAmaprayataM paya AtaYcya manTati' (Apa0 Da0 1.29.14). takrAdyAtaYcanena saMskftyetyarTaH.
'somena tvA''tanacmi' (tE0 saM0 1.1.3). Atanacmi GanIkaromi. tvA kzIram.
'prAtardugDaM dvEDaM kftvA tasyAnyatarAM BaktimAtacya tena' yajeta (E0 brA0 7.3). ukto'rTaH. AtaYcanaM dravyAntarasamprayogeRa GanIkaraRam.
